notes: GMSK: 1024 random soft bits +-1 at 9600 bit/s, levels 2, sps 8, bt 0.5, span 4, deviation 2400 Hz (symbol rate / 4); float64 chain: level +1 for a bit above 0 and -1 otherwise, upfirdn(h, levels, 8, 1) restricted to 8 outputs per bit with h = the boxcar of 8 ones convolved with design.gaussian(0.5, 8, 4), scaled to sum 8 and rounded to f32 (the taps of the block, D576), then phase += floor(x k + 0.5) modulo 2^32 with k = 2400 / 76800 2^32 from phase 0 and exp(j 2 pi phase / 2^32) with math.cos and math.sin
